thread:
Ava (PM): Quick sync note — field calls with ACME and BetaCorp this week flagged divergent needs for our private runtime packaging. want to align on priorities for next sprint.
Priya (Eng): TL;DR of asks?
Ava (PM): ACME wants a small-footprint installer for airgapped racks (slow disks, 2 GPU nodes). BetaCorp cares more about predictable upgrade paths and preserving customer IP ranges. both asked for clearer install-mode docs.
Miguel (Field Eng): ACME: installer should avoid heavy image pulls and support offline helm charts. Their infra team asked for a \"minimal\" mode that skips telemetry and optional components.
Jamal (SRE): Minimal mode needs safe defaults: automatic health probes offload, explicit opt-in for automatic rollbacks, and a clear manual revert procedure. otherwise we'll get support escalations.
Lina (Customer Success): BetaCorp emphasized non-disruptive upgrades during peak hours and retention of customer-assigned egress IPs. They also want a clear SLA for upgrade windows.
Priya (Eng): Rough engineering tradeoffs: small-footprint/airgap implies bundling compressed artifacts & multi-stage install script. Non-disruptive upgrades require operator-level migration steps or a blue/green operator. both increase bundle size/complexity.
Ava (PM): Proposal: split into two parallel tracks for the sprint: \"Installer: minimal/offline\" (ACME) and \"Upgrade ergonomics + IP preservation\" (BetaCorp). define must-have launch gates for each.
Miguel (Field Eng): For ACME minimal: launch gates -> 1) installer < 1GB additional on-disk, 2) offline install test pass on 2-node lab, 3) docs + checklist for field. I can own validation.
Jamal (SRE): For upgrade ergonomics: launch gates -> 1) preserve existing egress IPs for common topologies (NAT/gateway), 2) upgrade can be paused & rolled back within 15m, 3) automated pre-upgrade safety checks.
Priya (Eng): Implementation notes: I can spike a gated operator that supports a staged rollout with a manual pause hook. Need 3 sprint points for core operator, 2 for egress preservation plumbing (depends on CNI), 1 for tests.
Ava (PM): Customer priority weighting: ACME critical (paid pilot), BetaCorp high (enterprise prospect). Suggest we allocate 60% effort to ACME minimal this sprint and 40% to BetaCorp upgrade flows.
Lina (Customer Success): Agree on weighting. ACME escalation history means faster wins are strategic. We'll coordinate customer test windows.
Miguel (Field Eng): Quick ask: add a one-page "field runbook" to the deliverables so on-call knows the rollback steps. I can draft it.
Priya (Eng): Noted. Also: can we accept a temporary constraint that some CNI setups need manual steps for IP preservation in v1? avoid blocking overall rollouts.
Jamal (SRE): Acceptable if it's documented and surfaced in the pre-upgrade checks. add a telemetry event for \"upgrade-constraint-detected\" to route to field team.
deploy-bot: Build triggered: packaging/spike-minimal-installer #2234 -> CI started.
Ava (PM): Action items: Priya spike & 1st PR for operator (due EOW), Miguel to validate ACME offline test (lab run Thurs), Jamal to draft pre-upgrade checks & rollback template, Lina to schedule BetaCorp upgrade window next week. I'll update roadmap doc and cadence.
Priya (Eng): I'll post a short RFC with the operator API and install-mode flags.
Miguel (Field Eng): I'll upload lab logs and a small install log snippet once tests run.
Lina (Customer Success): I'll confirm BetaCorp window and share contact.
Jamal (SRE): I'll mock the pre-upgrade checklist and share in #eng-sre for review.
Ava (PM): cool — let's reconvene Friday 10:30 to close the gates and confirm dev allocation. :thumbsup:
Priya (Eng): ack.
Miguel (Field Eng): ack.
Lina (Customer Success): ack.
Jamal (SRE): ack.
